submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness is recommended because it achieves the best pion/kaon separation (3.8σ at 10 GeV/c) among all radiators that satisfy the critical ageing constraint. While R1 would provide better separation (4.6σ), it fails the humidity ageing test and therefore cannot be used since the radiator cannot be replaced during the 10-year run. R3 passes ageing but offers significantly lower separation (2.9σ). The thickness of 3 cm was determined through systematic optimization across the allowed 1-6 cm range, where R2 showed peak performance at 3 cm.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c
requirements.evidence: Among viable candidates (those passing ageing), R2 achieves 3.8σ separation at 10 GeV/c, compared to 2.9σ for R3. This is the best achievable separation given the constraints.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is one of the three evaluated candidates (R1, R2, R3).

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: R2_passes_ageing_constraint = 1, confirming R2 meets this hard requirement. R1 fails (value = 0) and was eliminated.
Recommended thickness of 3 cm is within the specified range of 1-6 cm.
